title: AEO Status Lifecycle and Tier Management
summary: The AEO status framework evolved from basic administrative procedures for application and suspension to a structured, multi-tiered system (Tier 1, 2, and 3). The process now includes formal mechanisms for tier promotion, demotion, and specific compliance-based cancellation, reflecting a more mature regulatory oversight model.

evolution.structure: Shifted from a flat status to a hierarchical Tier 1-3 system.
evolution.procedure: Added formal pathways for promotion and demotion based on performance and compliance.

timeline.change: Initial establishment of administrative forms for application deficiency, suspension, and cancellation.
Operationalization of AEO Centers and specialized customs teams to support status holders.
Formalization of rejection criteria for tier promotion and cancellation due to non-compliance.
Introduction of explicit tier-based promotion (Tier 1 to 2, 2 to 3) and demotion mechanisms, alongside temporary certification pathways.
